scenes.text: It's pouring, and you're getting soaked.
So you hold a leaf over your head. Way too small.
So you carry a giant board. Dry, but it weighs a ton.
So you stretch thin cloth over light sticks. Dry, and light.
But now it won't fit through the door.
So you hinge every stick to a ring that slides. Pull it down, it folds flat.
Wind flips it inside out? Bendy sticks snap it right back.
Congratulations. You just invented the umbrella.
